LESSON: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.6: Attributes of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Attributes of God. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God
2. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD
This lesson teaches Attributes of God for Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read scriptures on the attributes of God
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Attributes of God using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Attributes of God above.
2. Explain Attributes of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Attributes of God.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Attributes of God with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Attributes of God important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God
2. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
